newsitem.title: USA: Highwoods buys rest of Crocker stock.
newsitem.headline: Highwoods buys rest of Crocker stock.

text.p: Highwoods Properties Inc said Monday it has completed its acquisition of the remaining 23 percent of Crocker Realty Trust Inc's common stock for about $73.7 million.
The merger was completed September 20, 14 days after Highwoods purchased 77 percent of Crocker's outstanding shares.

The $73.7 million purchase price for the remaining 23 percent interest includes the purchase of about 2.1 million shares of common stock that were issued upon exercise of Crocker's outstanding warrants.
In connection with the exercise of the warrants, Crocker received about $21 million in cash, which are to be used for working capital, to repay certain debts and for other corporate purposes.
Highwoods Properties Inc is a real estate investment trust.
